target.definition: China's total retail sales of consumer goods in the single month of April 2026, as first reported by the National Bureau of Statistics of China.

inputs.name: annual_retail_sales_2026
inputs.description: China's total retail sales of consumer goods for the full calendar year 2026

provenance.rationale: 2024 total was about 48.8 trillion CNY; roughly 3-5% nominal growth gives about 50-51 trillion in 2026.

inputs.name: april_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Share of the full year's retail sales falling in April (a below-average month because January-February carries the Spring Festival boost)

provenance.rationale: April 2023 and April 2024 each came to about 7.3-7.5% of their full-year totals.

inputs.name: per_capita_monthly_retail
inputs.description: Average monthly retail spending per person in China

provenance.rationale: Annual per-capita retail sales of about 34,000-35,000 CNY spread over 12 months, with April slightly below the monthly average.
Population was about 1.408 billion in 2024 and is drifting slowly downward.

inputs.name: april_2025_retail_sales
inputs.description: China's total retail sales of consumer goods in April 2025

provenance.rationale: Recalled from the NBS monthly series: April 2025 retail sales were about 3.72 trillion CNY.

inputs.name: nominal_growth_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of April 2026 retail sales to April 2025 retail sales in nominal terms

provenance.rationale: Recent monthly nominal growth has run about 3-5%, with trade-in subsidies supporting goods sales.

paths.description: Take the full-year 2026 retail total and allocate the April share of it.
Multiply average monthly retail spending per person by the population.
Scale last year's same-month retail sales by the nominal year-on-year growth factor.

problems: path p1: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: annual_retail_sales_2026 ('CNY/year'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
